applicableClauses.note: A tablet that no longer powers on during normal use is a manufacturing defect covered by this clause.
Purchased in the European Union: 24-month warranty period. warranty_lookup reports the claim date within standard coverage.
The 12-month North America period does not apply; the product was purchased in the European Union.
The battery period does not apply; the reported failure is not a battery fault.
No drop, impact or screen damage reported or visible.
No liquid contact reported or visible.

structuredOutput.summary: Covered: a spontaneous power failure is a manufacturing defect under POL-8, and the claim, about 18 months after a purchase in the European Union, is within the 24-month EU warranty period of POL-2 as computed by warranty_lookup. The North America period (POL-1) does not apply and no exclusion (POL-4, POL-5) applies.
